answer.book: Latin text of Cato's Distichs on morals, 1598, printed with an Italian verse paraphrase and prose exposition by Scipione Lentolo: front matter (dedication, Latin verse, sonnet, address to the reader, preface), then the four books of Cato, each with its own preface or argument headings.
